package.name: gps_odometry_pkg
package.description: EKF-based GPS+Odometry localization stack (KF-2) for TurtleBot3 Burger. Runs ekf_local2 (continuous odom+IMU EKF) and ekf_filter_node_gps_enc (global GPS+Odometry EKF, output /odometry/global2). Feeds the BT fusion layer alongside KF-1. navsat_transform2 config is present but intentionally not launched to avoid a race condition on /odometry/gps.
